0022600027.text: The 76ers (8-1, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, on a five-game winning streak) visit the Cavaliers (4-4, sixth in the East, two games back in the Central, on a two-game losing streak) in this East Group B Emirates NBA Cup game, Philadelphia's 10th of the season after nine played. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Adem Bona (day-to-day, head, game-time decision), while Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (out, hamstring soreness), with Jarrett Allen (day-to-day, knee) and Tyrese Proctor (day-to-day, ankle) both game-time decisions. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 114-106 win in Philadelphia on October 22, and they lost the 2025-26 series 0-4.
